study.design: Elemental fingerprinting of whiskies by origin, type and age
study.origin: Scotland 106, USA 26, Ireland 15, Poland 10, Japan 3, India 3, Slovakia 3, UK 1, Azerbaijan 1, Wales 1, Bulgaria 1 (per label)
study.market: Polish market (supermarkets) and official whisky distributors; some distillates not for direct sale
study.method: Microwave HNO3 digestion; ICP-MS (22 elements incl. Cd, Pb, Cr, Ni, Sb, Sn, Tl, U), ICP-OES (Ca, Fe, K, Mg, P, S, Ti, Zn), CV-AAS for Hg
study.lod_text: LOD = blank mean + 3SD, LOQ = 3 LOD; values in Supplementary Table S2 (not in filed PDF)
study.qa: Indium internal standard; blanks; validation in Supplementary Table S1 (not in filed PDF); no CRM reported in main text

The companion paper (10.3390/foods11182810, Table 3) reprints these 170 samples with Ni mean 24.01 µg/L (confirming the 'N' row is Ni), Ca mean 14,655 µg/L, max 175,353 µg/L and S max 69,907 µg/L, supporting a decimal/thousands-separator error in this Table 2.
